rows.text: DNS Shield needs the system protection helper
rows.sub: Refuses the verified threat graph's malicious domains (and the lists you chose) for every app. Install it with Blackbox's installer (system protection), or from Blackbox Desktop.

rows.text: Threat Firewall needs the system protection helper
rows.sub: Drops traffic to and from the verified threat graph's malicious IP addresses. Install it with Blackbox's installer (system protection), or from Blackbox Desktop.
AI agents may reach any host.

rows.text: Cut malicious connections needs the system protection helper
rows.sub: Ends connections already open to listed addresses. Install it with Blackbox's installer (system protection), or from Blackbox Desktop.

rows.text: SSH lockdown needs the system protection helper
rows.sub: Only the addresses or networks you allow may SSH in. Install it with Blackbox's installer (system protection), or from Blackbox Desktop.
